findings.detail: 7 questions open with the same sentence (6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18): "Name the independent variable."
7 questions open with the same sentence (7, 9, 11, 13, 15, 17, 19): "Name the dependent variable."

issues.label: 1a
issues.detail: Question awards 2 marks but marking criteria are redundant: both criteria describe the same requirement (identifying angle of ramp as independent variable). One criterion should address identification, the other should address correct statement/expression.
issues.correction: Revise marking criteria to distinguish between identification and articulation, or reduce to 1 mark.

issues.label: 1b
issues.detail: Question awards 2 marks but marking criteria are redundant: both criteria describe the same requirement (identifying distance as dependent variable). One criterion should address identification, the other should address correct statement/expression.
issues.correction: Revise marking criteria to distinguish between identification and articulation, or reduce to 1 mark.

issues.label: 1c
issues.detail: Question asks for ONE variable (singular) but awards 4 marks with marking criteria listing THREE different acceptable control variables (marble type, starting position, surface). This is internally inconsistent - either ask for multiple variables or award fewer marks.
issues.correction: Change question to 'Name variables that must be kept the same' or reduce marks to 2 and accept any one valid control variable.

issues.label: 1 (all parts)
issues.detail: Figure description shows laboratory safety hazards (running, pushing, tasting chemicals, spills, loose tubing, etc.) but is completely irrelevant to the marble-ramp experiment context. The image does not support any question in this set.
issues.correction: Replace with relevant image showing ramp setup or remove image reference entirely.

issues.label: 2a
issues.detail: Topic label '7.1 Nutrients (7 Diet and growth)' is incorrect for an exercise-heart rate experiment. This belongs under Science Skills or human physiology, not nutrients/diet.
issues.correction: Change topic_label to 'Science Skills' to match the experimental design focus.

issues.label: 2b
issues.detail: Topic label '7.1 Nutrients (7 Diet and growth)' is incorrect for an exercise-heart rate experiment. This belongs under Science Skills or human physiology, not nutrients/diet.
issues.correction: Change topic_label to 'Science Skills' to match the experimental design focus.

issues.label: 3a
issues.detail: Topic label '7.4 Moving the body (7 Diet and growth)' is incorrect for a toy car rolling experiment. This is a physics/mechanics investigation, not related to human body movement.
issues.correction: Change topic_label to 'Science Skills' to match the experimental design focus.

issues.label: 3b
issues.detail: Topic label '7.4 Moving the body (7 Diet and growth)' is incorrect for a toy car rolling experiment. This is a physics/mechanics investigation, not related to human body movement.
issues.correction: Change topic_label to 'Science Skills' to match the experimental design focus.

issues.label: 5a

issues.label: 5b
issues.detail: Topic label '7.4 Moving the body (7 Diet and growth)' is incorrect for a plant growth in different soils experiment. This is botany/plant science, not related to human body movement.

issues.label: 7b
issues.detail: Marking criteria text is corrupted: 'Correct identification of the of as the dependent variable' - missing the actual variable name between 'the' and 'of'. Should read 'length of tadpoles'.
issues.correction: Correct to: 'Correct identification of the length of tadpoles as the dependent variable.'

issues.label: 8b

issues.correction: Correct to: 'Correct identification of the number of germinated seeds as the dependent variable.'

issues.label: 9b
issues.detail: Marking criteria text is corrupted: 'Correct identification of the of the as the dependent variable' - garbled text missing the actual variable. Should specify 'height of the plants'.
issues.correction: Correct to: 'Correct identification of the height of the plants as the dependent variable.'

issues.label: 10a
issues.detail: Hint text is corrupted: 'Identify the nutrient as the independent variable' - incomplete phrase. Should read 'nutrient type' or 'type of diet' to match the model answer.

review.summary: Assessment has 15 substantive issues: 1 irrelevant figure, 6 incorrect topic classifications, 3 redundant marking criteria, 1 mark-allocation inconsistency, and 5 corrupted text strings in marking criteria and hints requiring correction.
